prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent environmental prop sprite atlas for a 2D pixel-art platformer. Primary request: decorate the rocky upper slopes of Mayon volcano with ruins and volcanic boulders matching the supplied game artwork. Reference image 1 basalt.png defines the stone palette and pixel texture; reference image 2 broken_arch.png defines the old volcanic-stone masonry style; reference image 3 upper_vista.png defines the subdued dusk lighting. Create a NEW 1536x1024 RGBA atlas with an EXACT THREE-COLUMN by TWO-ROW grid, each cell 512x512, six independent props. TOP LEFT: a low crumbling wall of irregular dark volcanic masonry, jagged broken top and one thicker ruined buttress, no doorway. TOP MIDDLE: a solitary broken square stone pillar, chipped uneven top, plain old Cagsawa-like volcanic masonry, no fluting or classical capital. TOP RIGHT: a fallen masonry arch section lying diagonally among a few broken blocks, no standing archway. BOTTOM LEFT: a substantial angular basalt boulder with two smaller stones beside it. BOTTOM MIDDLE: a low wide cluster of loose volcanic boulders, shattered slabs and rubble. BOTTOM RIGHT: a cluster of three fractured angular columnar basalt spires of different heights. Each prop is a side-view game sprite with its base resting on a straight common baseline near the bottom of its own cell; the complete silhouette fits inside the cell with at least 32px transparent padding on ALL sides. No prop touches or overlaps another cell. Draw the props only, no scenery or ground platform. GENUINE TRANSPARENT alpha outside each prop, including holes and gaps. Style: detailed painted PIXEL ART, crisp stepped outlines and clustered square pixels, light from upper-left, desaturated charcoal/purple-grey basalt, warm dusty ochre sunlit facets, muted taupe old masonry, restrained detail that matches the references. Avoid smooth 3D rendering, vector contours, antialiasing, blur, glow and soft halos. The upper slope is barren: NO moss, grass, vines, flowers, trees, water, snow, lava, magical symbols, runes, skulls, treasure, doors, people, fences, text, labels, grid lines, checkerboard, borders, background or watermark. No cast shadow outside each sprite.
